description: Na₂O₂ is alpha boron-derived structured and crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅62m space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O¹⁻ atoms. There are four shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O¹⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and four longer (2.43 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O¹⁻ sites. In the first O¹⁻ site, O¹⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one O¹⁻ atom. The O-O bond length is 1.53 Å. In the second O¹⁻ site, O¹⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one O¹⁻ atom. The O-O bond length is 1.54 Å.
